_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Corrupted Betrayal#000.src: In {~} AP, {p} was on its knees. Hordes of undead were crippling the army and castle.
Corrupted Betrayal#000.dst: AP {~}년, {p}은(는) 무릎을 꿇기 직전이었다. 언데드 무리가 군대와 성을 무력화하고 있었다.

Corrupted Betrayal#002.src: Hey, soldier! Yeah, you! Got some spare time to lend a hand?
Corrupted Betrayal#002.dst: 어이, 병사! 그래, 너! 잠깐 시간 있으면 좀 도와줄래?
Corrupted Betrayal#002.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#003.src: We've got a major issue with this old fortress. It keeps spewing out all these damned slimes, and their proximity to {p} is causing issues.
Corrupted Betrayal#003.dst: 이 낡은 요새에 큰 문제가 생겼어. 빌어먹을 슬라임이 계속 쏟아져 나오는데, {p}에 너무 가까워서 골치야.
Corrupted Betrayal#003.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#004.src: Soldiers are spending half their guard duty slicing the critters into sludge. Ideally we'd raid the cave, cut out the source, but...
Corrupted Betrayal#004.dst: 병사들이 경계 근무의 절반을 놈들을 잘게 써는 데 쓰고 있어. 동굴을 쳐서 근원을 끊는 게 제일이지만...
Corrupted Betrayal#004.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#005.src: This place has some history. Nasty stuff. I'd prefer not to head in blind, so I've been checking for any clues to what we might find inside.
Corrupted Betrayal#005.dst: 여긴 역사가 좀 있어. 끔찍한 역사. 무작정 들어가긴 싫어서, 안에 뭐가 있을지 단서를 찾던 중이었어.
Corrupted Betrayal#005.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#006.src: Haven't found much... except this verse, 'scribed into the wall over there. Go on, check it out and let me know what you think.
Corrupted Betrayal#006.dst: 별건 못 찾았어... 저기 벽에 새겨진 시 한 구절 말고는. 가서 보고 어떻게 생각하는지 말해 줘.
Corrupted Betrayal#006.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#007.src: Nonsense, if you ask me. Most likely kids from {p} messing about. But we haven't found anything else, so... if you've got any time, fancy checking it out for me?
Corrupted Betrayal#007.dst: 내가 보기엔 헛소리야. 아마 {p} 애들 장난이겠지. 그래도 다른 단서가 없으니... 시간 되면 좀 알아봐 줄래?
Corrupted Betrayal#007.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#008.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#008.dst: 첫 줄은 분명 대교 얘기인데, 나머지는 무슨 뜻인지 모르겠어. 거기 가서 둘러보고, 흥미로운 게 있으면 알려 줘.
Corrupted Betrayal#008.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#009.src: Found anything interesting around the riddle yet? Do you need to hear it again?
Corrupted Betrayal#009.dst: 수수께끼 쪽에서 뭐 찾았어? 다시 들려줄까?
Corrupted Betrayal#009.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#010.src: Near a corrupted bridge, a ruin past its prime..
Corrupted Betrayal#010.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#011.src: Lives a cursed sheep, with the color of lime...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.dst: 라임빛 털을 한 저주받은 양이 사네...
Corrupted Betrayal#011.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#012.src: Lead it down the trail, headed to the slime...
Corrupted Betrayal#012.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#013.src: Sacrifice its soul, in the blood and the grime.
Corrupted Betrayal#013.dst: 피와 오물 속에 그 영혼을 바쳐라.
Corrupted Betrayal#013.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#014.src: The first line is obviously talking about the Great Bridge, but I've no clue what the rest means. Head over there, take a look around, and tell me if you find anything interesting.
Corrupted Betrayal#014.dst: 첫 줄은 분명 대교 얘기인데, 나머지는 무슨 뜻인지 모르겠어. 거기 가서 둘러보고, 흥미로운 게 있으면 알려 줘.
Corrupted Betrayal#014.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#015.src: Alrighty. Let me know what when you've got something then.
Corrupted Betrayal#015.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#016.src: Use the Mage's riddle to figure out where it leads

Corrupted Betrayal#017.src: If you are heading towards the Great Bridge, be cautious in the plains around the jungle entrance.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.dst: 대교로 간다면, 정글 입구 근처 평원에서 조심하세요.
Corrupted Betrayal#017.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#018.src: I have received reports of a strange cursed sheep taking refuge in one of the more fortified ruins around there.
Corrupted Betrayal#018.dst: 그 근처 요새화된 폐허에 이상한 저주받은 양이 숨어 있다는 보고가 들어왔어요.
Corrupted Betrayal#018.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#019.src: As far as I know, it is trapped in the ruins by some jungle growth, though if it was cut down it might escape...
Corrupted Betrayal#019.dst: 제가 알기로는 정글 덩굴에 막혀 폐허에 갇혀 있는데, 덩굴을 베면 도망칠지도...
Corrupted Betrayal#019.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#020.src: Explore the temple for a way to break the barrier.
Corrupted Betrayal#020.dst: 신전을 탐색해 방벽을 깰 방법을 찾으세요.

Corrupted Betrayal#021.src: Go to Slykaar's residence at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to find out what is hidden there.
Corrupted Betrayal#021.dst: [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]의 Slykaar 저택으로 가서 무엇이 숨겨져 있는지 알아내세요.

Corrupted Betrayal#022.src: By order of the city of {p}, I am here to keep other citizens from entering this house.
Corrupted Betrayal#022.dst: {p} 시의 명령으로, 시민들이 이 집에 들어가지 못하게 지키고 있어요.
Corrupted Betrayal#022.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#023.src: From past experiences, everyone who has entered this house has vanished from existence...
Corrupted Betrayal#023.dst: 지금까지 이 집에 들어간 사람은 모두 흔적도 없이 사라졌어요...
Corrupted Betrayal#023.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#024.src: I would advise not going inside unless you know what you are doing.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.dst: 뭘 하는지 잘 아는 게 아니라면 들어가지 마세요.
Corrupted Betrayal#024.speaker: Troms Guard

Corrupted Betrayal#025.src: Well, I guess you must know who I am.

Corrupted Betrayal#026.src: Welcome to my domain. I am the hero of {p}, Slykaar.
Corrupted Betrayal#026.dst: 내 영역에 온 걸 환영한다. 나는 {p}의 영웅, Slykaar다.

Corrupted Betrayal#027.src: Well, I used to be. Banished by the very people who asked for my help. Pathetic.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.dst: 뭐, 예전엔 그랬지. 도움을 청한 자들에게 쫓겨났다. 한심하군.
Corrupted Betrayal#027.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#028.src: They couldn't give me a few peasants for their safety? Weak.
Corrupted Betrayal#028.dst: 제 안전을 위해 농민 몇 명도 못 내준다고? 나약하군.
Corrupted Betrayal#028.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#030.src: I experimented my shamanism for many years underground to create the perfect mix of monster.
Corrupted Betrayal#030.dst: 완벽한 괴물을 만들려고 지하에서 오랜 세월 샤먼술을 실험했다.
Corrupted Betrayal#030.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#031.src: Most ended in horrific slimes. Aggressive and powerful, but alas, just slimes.
Corrupted Betrayal#031.dst: 대부분 끔찍한 슬라임이 됐지. 사납고 강하지만, 결국 슬라임일 뿐.
Corrupted Betrayal#031.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#032.src: Then I found this place. A dark land. A dark god. A source of power.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.dst: 그러다 이곳을 찾았다. 어둠의 땅. 어둠의 신. 힘의 원천.
Corrupted Betrayal#032.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#033.src: You mediocre wielders of magic have no idea what this world holds.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.dst: 어중간한 마법사 놈들은 이 세계에 뭐가 있는지 모른다.
Corrupted Betrayal#033.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#034.src: You all strive to be that hero of heroes, “Bob”, but here's the truth. He's lost. You're lost.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.dst: 다들 영웅 중의 영웅 “Bob”이 되려 하지만, 진실을 알려 주지. 그는 길을 잃었다. 너희도.
Corrupted Betrayal#034.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#035.src: No one in the Wynn province is willing to make the sacrifices I am to gain power.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.dst: Wynn 지방에서 힘을 얻으려 나만큼 희생할 자는 아무도 없다.
Corrupted Betrayal#035.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#036.src: If you want power, you have to give some. Sacrifice a few to save many.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.dst: 힘을 원하면 대가를 치러야지. 다수를 위해 소수를 희생하는 거다.
Corrupted Betrayal#036.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#037.src: They were willing to give me a few peasants in {~}, when the hordes crossed the bridge.
Corrupted Betrayal#037.dst: {~}년, 무리가 다리를 건너왔을 땐 농민 몇 명쯤 기꺼이 내줬지.
Corrupted Betrayal#037.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#038.src: The king was happy to throw away lives to save his. But then the hero of Wynn waltzed in a few years later.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.dst: 왕은 제 목숨을 위해 남의 목숨을 기꺼이 버렸다. 그런데 몇 년 뒤 Wynn의 영웅이 나타났지.
Corrupted Betrayal#038.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#039.src: They banished me like a rotten fruit. Their hero, their protector. So what if a few hundred nobodies died for it.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.dst: 놈들은 날 썩은 과일처럼 내쫓았다. 자기들의 영웅, 수호자를. 무명인 몇백 명 죽은 게 대수라고.
Corrupted Betrayal#039.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#040.src: Looks like we have a Bob aspirer. Pale imitation.
Corrupted Betrayal#040.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#041.src: So. Feel free to visit me down below, bring the entire might of the {p} army upon me. It will not be enough.
Corrupted Betrayal#041.dst: 그럼 얼마든지 아래로 찾아와라. {p} 군대를 전부 끌고 와도 좋다. 어림도 없을 테니.
Corrupted Betrayal#041.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#042.src: I am ready. Soon, {p} will be in ruins. And I shall have my revenge.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.dst: 준비는 끝났다. 곧 {p}은(는) 폐허가 되고, 나는 복수하리라.
Corrupted Betrayal#042.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#043.src: Go have fun in while you can. It's not like you have much of a life to live, anyways.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.dst: 놀 수 있을 때 실컷 놀아라. 어차피 살날도 얼마 안 남았으니.
Corrupted Betrayal#043.speaker: Slykaar

Corrupted Betrayal#044.src: Report back to Lanu about what you've learned.

Corrupted Betrayal#045.src: Ah, you're back. Find anything interesting? I've just been knocking back the occasional slime that pops up out of this cave.
Corrupted Betrayal#045.dst: 아, 돌아왔네. 뭐 좀 찾았어? 난 이 동굴에서 가끔 튀어나오는 슬라임이나 때려잡고 있었어.
Corrupted Betrayal#045.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#046.src: You... saw Slykaar? In another dimension?!
Corrupted Betrayal#046.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#047.src: This is bad. If he can materialise outside of this cave, even psychoactively... he's getting stronger. It explains the slimes, the attacks on {p}...
Corrupted Betrayal#047.dst: 큰일이네. 이 동굴 밖에 나타날 수 있다면, 정신체라도... 점점 강해지고 있는 거야. 슬라임도, {p} 습격도 설명이 돼...
Corrupted Betrayal#047.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#048.src: He's an incredibly powerful shaman, {u}. He has to be stopped, but it would take forever for {p} to mobile a force against him.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.dst: {u}, 그는 엄청나게 강한 샤먼이야. 막아야 하지만, {p}이(가) 부대를 모으려면 한참 걸릴 거야.
Corrupted Betrayal#048.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#049.src: If you can, you should head in there and... finish him off. Gear up first, though, and find some friends watch your back.
Corrupted Betrayal#049.dst: 할 수 있으면 들어가서... 끝장내 줘. 그래도 먼저 장비를 갖추고, 등 맡길 친구도 구해.
Corrupted Betrayal#049.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#050.src: {u}, how's it going? Run into another shaman hallucination at all?
Corrupted Betrayal#050.speaker: Lanu

Corrupted Betrayal#051.src: Anyway, good luck in the cave. If you choose to go in, be careful.
Corrupted Betrayal#051.dst: 아무튼 동굴에서 행운을 빌어. 들어가기로 했다면 조심해.
Corrupted Betrayal#051.speaker: Lanu
